title: Krull dimension of a filtered colimit is bounded by stage dimensions
statement: For a small filtered diagram R of commutative rings, ringKrullDim (colimit R) is at most the supremum of ringKrullDim (R.obj i).

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LK, conclusion of converse inequality

proof.text: By the finite-chain contraction result, every finite prime chain in the colimit has length bounded by the dimension of one stage and hence by the supremum; unfold the order-theoretic definition of ringKrullDim.
